shape.name: three-open-center-petals
shape.description: Three independent hollow teardrop petals, gently saddle-curved in depth, with separate inner bases and a clean central opening.
shape.topology: three separate closed petal loops, no crossings
shape.silhouette: A three-leaf floral outline with open center; no woven crossings and no spherical envelope.
shape.label: 三枚の花弁

motion.phaseMeaning: Each independent petal has phase 0 at its inner base, rising along both sides to phase 1 at the outer tip. group is the petal index.
rules: Animate brightness on anchored coordinates; never integrate particle positions over time.
Keep all structural points visible when idle, offline, or at zero activity.
Health selects one uniform color for the whole object; group is never a color category.
Use bounded, modulo-wrapped time. Activity changes speed and pulse amplitude, not the silhouette.
Reduced motion uses the rest coordinates and constant per-point weight.
motion.suggestion: Pulse gently from the three inner bases toward the petal tips. Use a soft whole-petal envelope if needed; never turn this into a circulating knot. All three petal outlines remain visible.

provenance: Approved monitoring-galaxy point-cloud form study; final deterministic provider geometry.

rendering.seedUsage: Stable visual variation only; never make silhouette depend on seed or elapsed time.
